titles.romaji: Dakaretai Otoko 1-i ni Odosarete Imasu.: Spain-hen
titles.english: DAKAICHI -I'm being harassed by the sexiest man of the year- the Movie: Spain Arc
titles.native: 劇場版 抱かれたい男1位に脅されています。～スペイン編～

description:
Azumaya and Takato are set to star in “Blood Wedding,” a two-person play that incorporates flamenco dancing. Takato begins rehearsing but realizes how vast the skill difference is between him and Azumaya. So he decides to travel to Spain in order to learn about passion. Azumaya is still stuck in the part of his past when Takato said goodbye to him without giving him any say in the matter...

(Source: Crunchyroll)
